headline: Mooring and Expanse Rage as Shelf Fight Quickens
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition the Weathered Expanse has reawakened with six changes in two hours and thirty-four in the day about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, the latest filed at the hour with holdings at three Warden to six Colonial and day losses above ten thousand on either side with rates still accelerating. Mooring County remains the busiest desk with seven changes in two hours and thirty-two in the day about Gravekeeper's Holdfast, The Cut and Wiccwalk, latest at 16:45, standing nine Warden to three Colonial with heavy accelerating casualties and enlistments. Stlican Shelf quickens at the wire with three changes in two hours and ten in the day about Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, latest at the hour, now three Warden, five Colonial and one neutral. Farranac Coast, lively at midday, records no change in two hours since the 15:15 filing at Transient Valley, still eleven Colonial. Stonecradle stays silent since 09:16 despite seventeen day changes about World's End and The Reach, Linn Mercy shows four day changes but none since last evening, while Callahans Passage reports severe day losses with quickening rates but no recorded flip.
